name: Parcelprawn
relevant_topic: Coordinating delivery assignments, routes, and changing conditions
match_rationale: Explains matching jobs to drivers or vehicles and adjusting routes as conditions change, with delivery use cases and a distinction between rules-based automation and AI-assisted decisions.
scope_label: Delivery dispatch context, not a complete live routing service
accessibility_reason: Public what-is article explains the everyday coordination problem, practical uses, and the role of human dispatchers without code.
why_workbooks_insufficient: No preserved workbook match explains delivery stop sequencing or operational time windows. Gradient optimization, token routing, and pipeline ordering do not explain delivery dispatch.
limitations: Vendor-authored and broader than delivery scheduling alone. Not every automated dispatch decision uses ML; human oversight, map quality, labor constraints, and safety still matter. No local deployment is implied.
owner_decision_note: Owner approved Parcelprawn's IBM Think dispatch-management educational reference.

name: Wardray
publisher: MIT News, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
article_title: Robot helps nurses schedule tasks on labor floor
relevant_topic: AI assistance with hospital task and resource scheduling
match_rationale: Explains how a system learns from staff to suggest nurse assignments and patient room moves, making hospital scheduling concrete without teaching readers to build a model.
scope_label: Hospital scheduling research example, not a complete hospital system
accessibility_reason: Public HTML news article introduces the everyday hospital problem and what the system recommends, without code or mathematical prerequisites.
why_workbooks_insufficient: The preserved workbook review found no lesson explaining operational nurse or hospital resource assignment. Neural optimization and data-pipeline ordering do not explain this job.
limitations: A 2016 research example, not evidence of current clinical deployment, clinical safety, or technology at any local hospital. Its particular learning method must not be added to Wardray's canonical algorithms as a deployment claim.
owner_decision_note: Owner approved Wardray's MIT News hospital-scheduling educational reference.

name: Routeopus
article_title: Can Artificial Intelligence Prevent Bus Bunching?
match_rationale: Explains buses arriving together, then how historical traffic and boarding data support delay predictions and timetable improvements that balance reliability and cost.
scope_label: Bus timetable improvement, not complete crew scheduling
accessibility_reason: Public HTML article starts with a familiar bus-stop problem, defines headway, and explains prediction plus schedule adjustment without code or equations.
why_workbooks_insufficient: No preserved workbook match explains operational vehicle scheduling. Expert routing, HTTP routing, and time-series inputs do not explain choosing a feasible bus timetable.
limitations: Vendor-authored 2018 explainer; dated generalizations about transit practice are not current facts. Focuses on reliability, not every scheduling constraint, and does not promise to eliminate delays or establish local deployment.
owner_decision_note: Owner held the accessible MIT trip-planning article because it is not directly about public transit scheduling; a replacement requires fresh owner approval.

name: Shiftshark
article_title: What is contact center workforce optimization?
relevant_topic: Matching staffing and schedules to demand and worker needs
match_rationale: Explains how demand forecasts, employee skills, preferences, and availability inform schedules, using a recognizable contact-center example of AI-assisted workforce planning.
scope_label: Workforce scheduling in a contact-center context, not every staffing system
accessibility_reason: Public what-is explainer defines the job, its uses, and AI assistance in prose without requiring programming or ML study.
why_workbooks_insufficient: The preserved workbook matches do not teach worker assignment or shift coverage. Data-pipeline scheduling and neural optimizer updates are different tasks.
limitations: Vendor-authored overview also discusses quality and coaching beyond scheduling. Contact centers illustrate the job rather than define every workplace. Optimization alone does not guarantee fair workloads or labor compliance.
owner_decision_note: Owner approved Shiftshark's IBM Think workforce-optimization educational reference.
